tweets.text:
Reverse psychology on Meta is crushing it right now.

Let's break this down to its deepest levels:

1. Whenever you tell them to do something they’re holding off. Whenever you tell them not to do it they’re confused. That confusion is exactly what brings Meta what they need from an ad - engagement. And your customer is hooked to find out what’s that all about. It’s a win-win situation, Facebook got what they want, customer got what they need in order to move forward. 

2. The whole idea of "Three benefits" here is to use the confusion you’ve created with your headline. Dependant on your product awareness you can go with part of your mechanism, features, benefits or points on why it’s different from others. High awareness = mechanism, low awareness = benefits. It'll be sort of a mindfuck for them and that is exactly what creates reactions and engagement which will turn into cheaper clicks without loosing the awareness. 

3. Image. This concept is build on confusion so you don’t wanna bring more of it through your image. Keep it simple, straight to the point, A/B test between stock image and organic iPhone made product image

606K sur le marché 🇫🇷 en 19 jours (full Meta)

La méthode est simple :
- Tu trouves un produit qui résout un maximum de problèmes où il y a de la demande, en te différenciant un max sur les arguments de vente, sur lequel tu as un reccuring et une bonne marge 
- Tu me follow (facultatif mais utile) 
- Tu crées ton site et balance une offre de 2 ou 3 variantes max avec un prix adapté au marché
- Tu crées tes 2 premières vidéos (en changeant le hook) sur lesquelles tu vas cibler un axe et un avatar seulement (préalablement redirigé). Tes vidéos doivent donner l’impression à ta cible qu’elle a été faite pour elle et pas une autre (le mass market tu oublies) 
- Tu les balances dans une campagne de testing en ABO avec 50€ de budget 
- Tu laissez tourner 4 jours grand minimum 

Ça prend : Tu scale en dupliquant ton ads winner dans une nouvelle campagne ABO de scaling avec 100€ (ou plus), sans toucher à celle de base. Puis tu déclines ta vidéo en changeant plusieurs éléments dans le montage et/ou le script, puis re balance ces nouvelles dans ta testing dans un nouvel adset

Ça ne prend pas : Tu analyses la cause :
- Atc mais pas de vente : Prix trop élevé (certainement une cible pas prête à acheter ta solution à ce prix) donc baisse le ou changes d’axe dans un nouveau testing si ta marge ne le permet pas
- Pas d’atc et bonnes stats Meta : Problème d’offre ou page de vente 
- Voyants rouge partout : Tu changes d’axe et/ou d’avatar sur ton nouveau testing 
- Stats Ok/BE : Laisse tourner l’adset et analyse tes metrics Meta pour mieux comprendre la cible pour un nouveau testing avec un avatar plus précis, ou axe si les stats sont au vert sur ton avatar 

Voilà.

Le thread sur la creative parfaite arrive bientôt, j’essaie d’avancer dessus quand j’ai un peu de temps 

Si ce thread t’a aidé : un like ne coûte rien.

Je réponds a toutes les questions (hésitez pas à relancer au besoin)

Looking for a marketing subject matter expert (which means you either own a small $1M-5M agency OR are director of marketing at a company that uses direct response).

I’m looking for someone who owned or owns a marketing agency for B2C companies, business coaching for B2C companies, or ran marketing at one of those companies. To be clear, I don’t need a vendor. I'm looking for someone who wants to stop doing that and wants to work at Acquisition. com.

Marketing Director – Acquisition. com

I need someone who understands B2B paid ads and sales while also understanding the dynamic of B2C businesses and email marketing. I need your skills in two use cases. First, to help us tackle the ever growing list of opportunities in front of us at Acquisition .com. Second, to help our advisory clients tackle the problems in front of them. This is hands-on work building tools, frameworks, and plans that drive real growth.  

You have to be the type of person who already spends your discretionary money & time on learning more about marketing. If this isn’t what you spend your free time doing, you wont be able to keep up. You’ll work with our SMEs, leadership, and portfolio companies—some of the best operators out there.  

The Job:
- Know how to use all the saas tools for marketing and sales
- Speak the language of marketing (LTV, CAC, CPA, Deliverability, Open Rates, CTRs, etc)
- Know what actions change the acquisition numbers across a business
- Help ACQ & its advisory clients solve real problems & improve throughput

The Deal:
- $200k–$300k base + bonus (50%-100% of base) + benefits (health, 401k match, gym access).  TLDR: is a $250k to $600k per year role based on skill & performance.
- Vegas HQ + generous relocation package + temporary housing coverage
- Hybrid setup—onsite when it counts, flex when it doesn’t.  
- Direct line to leadership & our advisory crew.  

You:
- Owned a marketing agency, or business coaching for a B2C businesses OR director of marketing/revenue at one of the above
- Know how to drive revenue in a business across multiple channels (paid ads, content, email, affiliates, outbound)
- Know how to present and communicate to business owners

This is fast, intense, and built for impact. If you’re cut for it, apply at the link in the comments.  

PS - If this isn’t you, but you know someone who fits? Send them the link below (first comment) or tag them.
